El componente `DropdownMenu` proporciona agrupación de elementos, submenús y un interruptor personalizable. Los elementos del menú desplegable se configuran con la propiedad `items`. Por defecto, el interruptor del menú es un botón con el icono de puntos suspensivos (**⋯**), que puede ser anulado con la propiedad `renderSwitcher`.

```tsx
import {DropdownMenu} from '@gravity-ui/uikit/legacy';
```

GRAVITY_TRANSLATION_BLOCK_1_END

GRAVITY_TRANSLATION_BLOCK_2_END

## Elementos agrupados

Los elementos de `DropdownMenu` se pueden agrupar y separar visualmente de otros elementos del menú introduciendo arrays de elementos de menú anidados en el array `items`.

GRAVITY_TRANSLATION_BLOCK_3_END

GRAVITY_TRANSLATION_BLOCK_4_END

## Submenús

La propiedad `items` en un elemento de menú individual añade sub-elementos anidados a dicho elemento.

Los elementos de menú con submenús obtienen los siguientes nombres de clase adicionales para permitir un estilo extra:

- `.g-dropdown-menu-legacy__menu-item_with-submenu`: Para elementos con más de un elemento anidado.
- `.g-dropdown-menu-legacy__menu-item_active-parent`: Para el elemento cuyo submenú está actualmente abierto.

GRAVITY_TRANSLATION_BLOCK_5_END

GRAVITY_TRANSLATION_BLOCK_6_END

## Interruptor de menú personalizado

Para configurar el interruptor del menú, utiliza la propiedad `renderSwitcher`. Puede ser cualquier función que devuelva un componente React (o cualquier `(props: SwitcherProps) => React.ReactNode` en términos de TypeScript, consulta [`SwitcherProps`](#switcherprops) a continuación). Por defecto, el interruptor del menú es un botón con el icono de puntos suspensivos (**⋯**).

GRAVITY_TRANSLATION_BLOCK_7_END

GRAVITY_TRANSLATION_BLOCK_8_END

El ejemplo anterior está simplificado en exceso para demostrar la idea del interruptor de menú personalizable. En una aplicación real, generalmente se recomienda que el interruptor de menú clicable sea un componente accesible con teclado y otras tecnologías de asistencia, como un botón.

## Iconos personalizados

Puedes añadir iconos personalizados a un elemento de `DropdownMenu` utilizando la propiedad `iconStart` o `iconEnd`. Por defecto, los elementos de `DropdownMenu` no llevan iconos.

Puedes cambiar el icono del interruptor del menú con las propiedades `renderSwitcher` de `DropdownMenu`. Por defecto, el interruptor del menú es un botón con el icono de puntos suspensivos (**⋯**).

GRAVITY_TRANSLATION_BLOCK_9_END

GRAVITY_TRANSLATION_BLOCK_10_END

## Propiedades

| Nombre                       | Descripción                                                                                        |                        Tipo                        |    Por defecto    |
| :------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------: | :-----------: |
| `items`                    | Array de elementos. Los arrays anidados de elementos representan grupos visualmente separados.                        | `(DropdownMenuItem \| DropdownMenuItem[])[] \| []` |               |
| `data`                     | Una carga útil proporcionada a las acciones llamadas desde el menú. (Esto puede ser útil para menús contextuales).    |                       `any`                        |               |
| `icon`                     | Icono del `switcher` por defecto.                                                                    |                 `React.ReactNode`                  | Icono de puntos suspensivos |
| `size`                     | Aplicado tanto al `switcher` por defecto como al menú.                                               |            `'s' \| 'm' \| 'l' \| 'xl'`             |     `'m'`     |
| `disabled`                 | Establecer esta propiedad en `true` deshabilita el botón `switcher` y evita que se abra el menú. |                     `boolean`                      |               |
| `renderSwitcher`           | Función de renderizado para el control de alternancia del menú.                        |                 `React.ReactNode`                  |               |
| `switcherWrapperClassName` | Valor para la propiedad `className` del componente padre del `switcher`.                           |                      `string`                      |               |
| `defaultSwitcherProps`     | Propiedades por defecto del `switcher`.                                                                     |                   `ButtonProps`                    |               |
| `defaultSwitcherClassName` | Valor para la propiedad `className` del `switcher` por defecto.                                      |                      `string`                      |               |
| `menuProps`                | Anula las propiedades emergentes del menú desplegable por defecto.                                              |                    `MenuProps`                     |               |
| `popupProps`               | Anula las propiedades emergentes por defecto.                                                            |                    `PopupProps`                    |               |
| `open`                     | Alterna la visibilidad del menú desplegable.                                                                  |                     `boolean`                      |               |
| `onOpenToggle`             | Se llama cuando el menú se abre o se cierra.                                                          |                    `() => void`                    |               |
| `onSwitcherClick`          | Se llama cuando se hace clic en `switcher`.                                                                 |       `React.MouseEventHandler<HTMLElement>`       |               |
| `hideOnScroll`             | Especifica si se debe ocultar el menú cuando se desplaza un elemento padre.                              |                     `boolean`                      |    `true`     |
| `children`                 | Contenido personalizado dentro del popup del menú.                                                              |                 `React.ReactNode`                  |               |

### DropdownMenuItem

Este tipo describe los elementos individuales de un menú desplegable.
GRAVITY_TRANSLATION_BLOCK_1_END
### DropdownMenu

This component renders a menu that can be triggered by a button or other element.
GRAVITY_TRANSLATION_BLOCK_2_END
### DropdownMenu.Item

This component renders an individual dropdown menu item. It should be used as a child of `DropdownMenu`.
GRAVITY_TRANSLATION_BLOCK_3_END
### DropdownMenu.Separator

This component renders a separator between dropdown menu items. It should be used as a child of `DropdownMenu`.
GRAVITY_TRANSLATION_BLOCK_4_END
### DropdownMenu.Trigger

This component renders the element that triggers the dropdown menu. It should be used as a child of `DropdownMenu`.
GRAVITY_TRANSLATION_BLOCK_5_END
### DropdownMenu.Content

This component renders the content of the dropdown menu. It should be used as a child of `DropdownMenu`.
GRAVITY_TRANSLATION_BLOCK_6_END
### DropdownMenu.Label

This component renders a label for a group of dropdown menu items. It should be used as a child of `DropdownMenu`.
GRAVITY_TRANSLATION_BLOCK_7_END
### Props

Props that can be passed to the `DropdownMenu` component.

| Prop Name | Type | Default | Description |
| :-------- | :--- | :------ | :---------- |
| `open` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the dropdown menu is open. |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` | `null` | Callback fired when the dropdown menu is opened or closed. |
| `modal` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the dropdown menu should be modal. |
| `dir` | `'ltr' | 'rtl'` | The text direction of the dropdown menu. |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | `false` | The initial open state of the dropdown menu when it is uncontrolled. |
| `onCloseAutoFocus` | `(event: Event) => void` | `null` | Callback fired when the dropdown menu is closed. Called before the `onOpenChange` callback. |
| `onEscapeKeyDown` | `(event: KeyboardEvent) => void` | `null` | Callback fired when the escape key is pressed. |
| `onPointerDownOutside` | `(event: Event) => void` | `null` | Callback fired when a pointer event occurs outside the dropdown menu. |
| `onFocusOutside` | `(event: Event) => void` | `null` | Callback fired when a focus event occurs outside the dropdown menu. |
| `onInteractOutside` | `(event: Event) => void` | `null` | Callback fired when an interaction event occurs outside the dropdown menu. |
| `onDismiss` | `() => void` | `null` | Callback fired when the dropdown menu is dismissed. |
| `disableClosingOnEscape` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether to disable closing the dropdown menu on escape key press. |
| `disableClosingOnPointerDownOutside` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether to disable closing the dropdown menu on pointer down outside. |
| `disableClosingOnFocusOutside` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether to disable closing the dropdown menu on focus outside. |
| `disableClosingOnInteractOutside` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether to disable closing the dropdown menu on interact outside. |
| `preventScrollOnBody` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether to prevent scrolling on the body when the dropdown menu is open. |
| `arrowOffset` | `number` | `0` | The offset of the arrow from the trigger. |
| `arrowPadding` | `number` | `0` | The padding of the arrow. |
| `collisionBoundary` | `Element | null` | `null` | The boundary element for collision detection. |
| `collisionPadding` | `number` | `0` | The padding for collision detection. |
| `hideWhenDetached` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether to hide the dropdown menu when it is detached from the trigger. |
| `position` | `'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right'` | `'bottom'` | The position of the dropdown menu relative to the trigger. |
| `align` | `'start' | 'center' | 'end'` | `'start'` | The alignment of the dropdown menu relative to the trigger. |
| `sideOffset` | `number` | `0` | The offset of the dropdown menu from the trigger along the side. |
| `alignOffset` | `number` | `0` | The offset of the dropdown menu from the trigger along the alignment axis. |
| `avoidCollisions` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether to avoid collisions with the viewport. |
| `updatePositionStrategy` | `'always' | 'வுகளில்'` | `'always'` | The strategy for updating the position of the dropdown menu. |
| `className` | `string` | `''` | The CSS class name for the dropdown menu. |
| `style` | `React.CSSProperties` | `{}` | The inline styles for the dropdown menu. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | `null` | The children of the dropdown menu. |
GRAVITY_TRANSLATION_BLOCK_8_END

### Examples

#### Basic DropdownMenu

```jsx
import { DropdownMenu } from 'your-ui-library';

function App() {
  return (
    <DropdownMenu>
      <DropdownMenu.Trigger>Open Menu</DropdownMenu.Trigger>
      <DropdownMenu.Content>
        <DropdownMenu.Item>Item 1</DropdownMenu.Item>
        <DropdownMenu.Item>Item 2</DropdownMenu.Item>
        <DropdownMenu.Separator />
        <DropdownMenu.Item disabled>Disabled Item</DropdownMenu.Item>
      </DropdownMenu.Content>
    </DropdownMenu>
  );
}
```

#### Controlled DropdownMenu

```jsx
import { DropdownMenu } from 'your-ui-library';
import React from 'react';

function App() {
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);

  return (
    <DropdownMenu open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <DropdownMenu.Trigger>Open Menu</DropdownMenu.Trigger>
      <DropdownMenu.Content>
        <DropdownMenu.Item>Item 1</DropdownMenu.Item>
        <DropdownMenu.Item>Item 2</DropdownMenu.Item>
      </DropdownMenu.Content>
    </DropdownMenu>
  );
}
```

### Accessibility

The `DropdownMenu` component has been designed with accessibility in mind. It follows the WAI-ARIA guidelines for dropdown menus.

*   **Keyboard Navigation:** Users can navigate the menu using the arrow keys, Enter key to select an item, and Escape key to close the menu.
*   **Screen Reader Support:** The component uses appropriate ARIA attributes to ensure screen readers can interpret the menu structure and state correctly.
*   **Focus Management:** Focus is managed appropriately when the menu opens and closes, ensuring a smooth user experience for keyboard and screen reader users.

**Key ARIA Attributes Used:**

*   `role="menu"` on the content container.
*   `role="menuitem"` on each selectable item.
*   `aria-haspopup="true"` on the trigger element.
*   `aria-expanded` on the trigger element to indicate the menu's open/closed state.
*   `aria-controls` to associate the trigger with the menu content.
*   `aria-disabled` on disabled menu items.
GRAVITY_TRANSLATION_BLOCK_44_END
### Styling

The `DropdownMenu` component can be styled using the `className` and `style` props. You can also use the `sx` prop for inline styling with theme support.

#### CSS Classes

The following CSS classes are applied to the `DropdownMenu` components:

| Component           | Class Name          |
| :------------------ | :------------------ |
| `DropdownMenu`      | `dropdown-menu`     |
| `DropdownMenu.Item` | `dropdown-menu-item`|
| `DropdownMenu.Separator` | `dropdown-menu-separator` |
| `DropdownMenu.Trigger` | `dropdown-menu-trigger` |
| `DropdownMenu.Content` | `dropdown-menu-content` |
| `DropdownMenu.Label` | `dropdown-menu-label` |

#### Inline Styles

You can apply inline styles using the `style` prop:

```jsx
<DropdownMenu style={{ border: '1px solid #ccc' }}>
  {/* ... */}
</DropdownMenu>
```

#### Theme Support (using `sx` prop)

If your UI library provides theme support, you can use the `sx` prop for styling:

```jsx
<DropdownMenu sx={{ backgroundColor: 'primary.main', color: 'primary.contrastText' }}>
  {/* ... */}
</DropdownMenu>
```
GRAVITY_TRANSLATION_BLOCK_45_END
### Caveats

*   The `DropdownMenu` component relies on a positioning library (e.g., Popper.js or Floating UI) for correct placement. Ensure this dependency is available in your project.
*   When using `asChild` on the `DropdownMenu.Trigger`, ensure the child element is focusable and can receive events.
*   Complex nesting of `DropdownMenu` components might require careful consideration of focus management and event propagation.

### SwitcherProps

| Nombre        | Descripción                                                              |     Tipo     |
| :------------ | :----------------------------------------------------------------------- | :----------: |
